name: claudish-to-english
description: Shows a plain-English rewrite of each Claude Code assistant message, produced by your Claude Code subscription via the local claude CLI (the default, which sends message text to Anthropic), a local LLM via ollama, the Anthropic API, or any OpenAI-compatible API. ollama is the only provider under which nothing leaves your machine. Display-only: Claude's reasoning and the transcript keep the original text.
